title: SG-8.4.4 Contribution history error message with Retry
summary: Show 'Could not load your suggestions' with a Retry button when history fails, and Retry returns to loading
description: Context: ContributionSheet already loads history through listMine and has a HistoryStatus of loading, ready or error, plus a Retry button driven by reloadKey. Desired behavior: when history fails, the player sees 'Could not load your suggestions' with a Retry button, and clicking Retry reloads the history and returns to the loading state. Expected result: the behavior is confirmed in code and locked by unit tests. Why: the player must be able to recover from a failed history load without closing the modal.
acceptance_criteria: Given listMine rejects, When the sheet opens, Then role=alert shows 'Could not load your suggestions' and a Retry button is present
Given the error state, When Retry is clicked, Then the error message and Retry button disappear and 'Loading your suggestions…' is shown while listMine is pending
Given Retry is clicked, When listMine is called again and resolves, Then listMine has been called twice and the history list is shown

in_scope: ContributionSheet history error and Retry behavior

technical_constraints: React + Zustand-free local state in ContributionSheet
Use the real api client module, mocked only in unit tests
definition_of_done: Error message and Retry present on failure
Retry returns to loading and reloads history
